scalar: dot(unchanged cached normalized query, normalized product CLS)
baseline_rule: Replace every active non-special non-padding word vector, including fixed fields and separators; retain masks, specials, padding and model-native positions.
diagnostic: The same native FP16-rounded parameters converted to FP32, eval, no training, no TF32.

acceptance.boundary: both fresh and diagnostic preserve native inclusion; abs(native margin) > 5*max(abs(diagnostic-native),abs(fresh-native))

figures.full_order: C0 occurrence order then separate fixed fields/separators/boundary/special/padding
figures.compact_selection: first 10 C0 occurrences; exact sum of remaining 94 attributes; separate fixed groups

limits: Only this case, four IG combinations; no local moves, no extra orders for IG; no case substitution or relaxed thresholds. Stability is not a confidence interval or true error bound.
failure_policy: Retain every attempt. PAD plot only if all core checks pass. Zero failure is explicit. No unlabeled failed attribution figure. Preserve native figure when diagnostic fails.
